result:
Found it. In the pinned development source (commit `9c28114a`, tagged v1.3.1), `snappy/snappy-internal.h:63-66` defines it conditionally:

```c
#if SNAPPY_HAVE_SSSE3 || SNAPPY_HAVE_NEON
#define SNAPPY_HAVE_VECTOR_BYTE_SHUFFLE 1
#else
#define SNAPPY_HAVE_VECTOR_BYTE_SHUFFLE 0
#endif
```

So there is no single unconditional value — it is `1` on x86 with SSSE3 or ARM with NEON, and `0` otherwise. (Its uses, e.g. `Copy64BytesWithPatternExtension` at `snappy.cc:363`, select the V128 shuffle path when it is 1.)

ANSWER: 1 if SNAPPY_HAVE_SSSE3 || SNAPPY_HAVE_NEON, else 0 (conditional define at snappy-internal.h:63-66)
